name: Fodda
description: Trend intelligence and consumer behavior agent. Provides expert-curated knowledge graphs and synthetic analyst personas across retail, beauty, luxury, fashion, sport, consumer electronics, food and beverage, and brand strategy. Returns structured signals with evidence chains, not generic web summaries.

securitySchemes.description: API key via X-API-Key header. Free tier: 100 calls/month. Issued at fodda.ai/account
Machine Payments Protocol (MPP). Zero-onboarding: hit any endpoint without credentials, receive HTTP 402 with pricing, then pay per-request via Authorization: Bearer spt_xxx
Enterprise SSO via OIDC. Authorization: Bearer <jwt>

skills.name: Search trend knowledge graphs
skills.description: Search Fodda's expert-curated knowledge graphs for trend clusters, signals, and consumer behavior patterns across retail, beauty, luxury, fashion, sport, consumer electronics, F&B.
examples: Find signals about Gen Z beauty behavior in APAC
Show trend clusters in pop-up retail

skills.name: Consult synthetic analyst persona
skills.description: Have a structured conversation with an expert synthetic analyst (e.g., Piers Fawkes for trends and innovation, Ben Dietz for luxury and SIC) trained on years of editorial intelligence.
examples: Ask Ben Dietz about luxury fashion tech and prediction markets
Consult Piers Fawkes on food service and retail convergence

skills.name: Build brand intelligence profile
skills.description: Generate a structured Brand Intelligence Profile by searching across all Fodda knowledge graphs for a given brand. Returns positioning signals, adjacent trends, competitor context, and evidence sources.
examples: Build a brand profile for Aesop
Track Nike across all relevant graphs

skills.name: Query domain knowledge graphs
skills.description: Search PSFK-curated domain graphs (retail, beauty, fashion, sport, F&B) for topic-specific intelligence.

skills.name: Query earnings call intelligence
skills.description: Search earnings call intelligence across companies, industries, or sectors. Includes divergence detection between analyst concerns and management responses.
examples: What did beauty companies say about Gen Z in Q1 earnings?
Find earnings divergence in luxury sector

skills.name: Autonomous deep research
skills.description: Launch an autonomous deep research session on a topic, returning structured findings with evidence chains from across the Fodda graph network.
examples: Run deep research on intentional inefficiency as a retail counter-trend
Investigate luxury fashion tech and prediction markets
